description: “Dialogue should be established with major tech companies, including the Tata Group, to develop Lucknow as an 'AI City',” he said on Wednesday during a high-level review of the UPDCC programme, Project Ganga, and possible exemption from mandi fee and cess to promote in-house processing of wheat.
body_lead: NEW DELHI: The Uttar Pradesh Data Centre Cluster (UPDCC) will create the infrastructure for the state’s artificial intelligence ( AI ) mission, said Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath . CM Adityanath said that the project can begin from the Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA) region, where large-scale land is available.
